title: Thoughtspecter
summary:
Thoughtspecter is an illusory spell. It is used to create illusions, usually replicas of humans or Titans to cover for an escape or to distract an opponent.

The spell is similar to the illusory abilities of Madea.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Ever since he was afflicted with the Curse of the Legendary Titans, the Professor had been using a power akin to Thoughtspecter to hide the effects of the curse on his body. [The Divine Comedy]

Zhalia Moon learnt the spell from the power from Jason's tablet on Madea Island. [The Beautiful Trap] 

Zhalia used the spell right away to create a clone of Lindorm and distract the raging Titan, so that Lok Lambert could send it back to its amulet. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

In the Valley of the Kings, Egypt, Zhalia used the spell to escape from Klaus's forces, masking their escape with an illusion of a sandstorm. [All Work and No Pay] 

While the team was investigating the Castle of Vlad Dracul, Zhalia used Thoughtspecter to create a duplicate of herself during her duel with Sophie Casterwill. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

As Zhalia severed her ties with the Organization, she set her apartment to explode and trick the Suits into believing she died, then used Thoughtspecter to become invisible and sneak out of the city. [The Unseen Guide] 

In the desert, after Zhalia had been taken captive by the Professor, she used an illusory spell, presumed by Rassimov to be Thoughtspecter, to create a blinding yellow aura, allowing herself and the team to escape. [To Be Together]

While the team travelled to Tower of Nostradamus in , Zhalia used Thoughtspecter to create decoys of the members in order to evade the The Organization's combat choppers's missiles augmented with Targetfind. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

At the Casterwill Library in Paris, Zhalia used Thoughtspecter to conceal her Kilthane, Gar-Ghoul, and King Basilisk Titans to gain an upper hand against Lucas Casterwill, Lane, and Dellix. [Chasing Void]

On Medusa's Island, Thoughtspecter was used by Zhalia so the team could retreat from the Blood Spiral with Medusa's Amulet. [Zhalia's Mission]
